clips.caption:
A researcher took ordinary water, said "thank you" to it, froze it, and looked at the crystal under a microscope. It formed something symmetrical, almost beautiful. Then he said "you fool" to the same water. What formed was broken apart.

It didn't matter if the word was written, spoken, or only thought. The water answered the same way every time — and you're made of that same water, almost entirely.

There's a photo of polluted water before someone prayed over it, and the same water an hour later. They don't look like they came from the same place.

Comment RISE and I'll send you what this means for the words you use on yourself.

#frequency #manifestation #subconscious #energy #awakening #kevintrudeau

There's research on this that most people have never heard: when you send a curse, an insult, even just a bitter thought toward someone, it does affect them — but it affects the water in your own body 100 times more than it affects theirs.

Compassion runs the same current in reverse. Wish someone well, forgive them, see the best in them, and that frequency moves through your own body first, before it ever reaches them.

You were never really hurting anyone else. You were deciding which version of yourself you'd be made of.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to clear the ones you're still carrying.

#subconscious #frequency #manifestation #energy #awakening #kevintrudeau

Picture two marionettes on a stage, fighting each other with swords. One stabs the other, it falls, and from where you're sitting you just watched a fight — a winner, a loser, good versus evil.

Then you look up. There's only one pair of hands, one puppeteer, controlling both of them the entire time. There was never a fight. There was one awareness, moving through two separate-looking bodies.

That's the oldest teaching hiding under almost every spiritual tradition — behind every person you've judged, loved, envied or feared, there's the same one pulling the strings. You included.

Comment RISE and I'll send you what happens once you actually see the hands.

#oneness #consciousness #awakening #manifestation #subconscious #kevintrudeau

Every guru who's actually arrived gives the same answer for the one secret. Not a technique, not a ritual. Just: there's one — one awareness behind everyone — and you love all of it, without exception, including yourself.

That last part is the one people skip. You can recite "we are all one" and still talk to yourself worse than you'd talk to a stranger. The teaching isn't finished until the exception you make for yourself is gone too.

This is what's described as the veil lifting — not a reward you earn, just what's left once separation stops feeling real.
